data.title: USDA Raises 2026/2027 U.S. Soybean Output and Ending Stocks Forecasts
data.description: According to Jin10, the U.S. Department of Agriculture said September forecasts for U.S. 2026/2027 soybean production were 4.535 billion bushels, compared with market expectations of 4.501 billion bushels and August forecasts of 4.519 billion bushels. It also put September forecasts for U.S. 2026/2027 soybean ending stocks at 310 million bushels, versus market expectations of 298 million bushels and August forecasts of 320 million bushels, while September forecasts for soybean yield were 52.8 bushels per acre, compared with market expectations of 52.5 bushels per acre and August forecasts of 52.7 bushels per acre.

data.title: USDA Projects U.S. Soybean Ending Stocks at 310 Million Bushels
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the U.S. Department of Agriculture projected U.S. soybean ending stocks at 310 million bushels, above analysts' estimate of 291.37 million bushels and its previous forecast of 320 million bushels.

data.title: USDA Projects U.S. Corn Ending Stocks at 1.510877 Billion Bushels
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the U.S. Department of Agriculture projected U.S. corn ending stocks at 1.510877 billion bushels, compared with analysts' estimate of 1.5108 billion bushels and the USDA's previous forecast of 1.653 billion bushels.

data.title: USDA projects U.S. cotton ending stocks at 3.6 million bales, below analysts' 3.79 million
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the U.S. Department of Agriculture projected U.S. cotton ending stocks at 3.6 million bales, below analysts' expectation of 3.79 million and its previous estimate of 4 million bales.

data.title: Chevron Says Venezuela Oil Sales Will Fund $7 Billion Expansion
data.description:
Chevron Corp. said its $7 billion expansion in Venezuela will be financed with profits from crude produced and sold in the country, rather than outside cash injections, according to Bloomberg.

The comment came from Chevron Chief Executive Officer Mike Wirth, who said the oil giant expects the project to be self-funded through Venezuelan operations.

data.title: Nippon Steel Opens 300 Billion Yen Hot Rolling Line In Japan
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, Nippon Steel is bringing a new 300 billion yen ($1.96 billion) hot rolling line online in Japan despite sinking domestic demand. The company is betting there is still market share to win from rivals in the automotive sector.

data.title: Japan Weighs Defense Subsidies to Boost Ammunition, Drone Output
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, Japan is looking to offer defense subsidies that would support capital spending to expand domestic production capacity for items such as ammunition and drones needed in large quantities during a threat to national security.

data.title: US Inflation Surprise Tied to Higher Cellphone Service Prices
data.description:
A record jump in cellular phone service prices helped push a key US inflation gauge above forecasts, likely locking in a Federal Reserve interest-rate increase next week, according to Bloomberg.

The source said the move in phone service costs helped tip the measure higher.

data.title: STOCKS | MSCI Nordic Countries Index Falls 0.1% as Healthcare Leads Declines
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the MSCI Nordic Countries Index fell 0.1% to 396.11, with healthcare posting the biggest decline among the 10 sectors and Coloplast A/S down 3.9% as the worst performer among Nordic stocks.

data.title: Maharashtra Drafts Policy to Tokenize Power Infrastructure and Property
data.description: Maharashtra is developing a policy that could tokenize electricity transmission infrastructure and direct the proceeds toward new power lines and energy storage. According to NS3.AI, the state is also drafting the DELTA Act, which could make Maharashtra the first Indian state with a dedicated law governing blockchain-based property tokenization.

data.title: Mercuria, Glencore Said to Pursue Venezuela’s Largest Aluminum Smelter
data.description:
Mercuria Energy Group Ltd. and Glencore Plc are among firms interested in a deal for Venezuela’s largest aluminum smelter, according to Bloomberg.

The potential transaction would mark a push by major commodity traders into Venezuela’s beleaguered industrial sector.

data.title: Hassett Says Trump’s $5,000 Checks Can Be Done Responsibly
data.description: White House National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett said US President Donald Trump’s suggestion of sending $5,000 checks to every adult US citizen is “a serious proposal” and can be done “in a fiscally responsible way,” according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Polymarket Whale Buys $87,057 Bet on 25-Basis-Point Fed Hike
data.description: A large资金 move was recorded on prediction market Polymarket in the Federal Reserve's September decision event, where a whale bought a single position on a 25-basis-point increase for $87,057.89. According to ChainCatcher, the contract's latest implied probability is 80.61% based on the current trading price.

data.title: Bitcoin Concept Proof Runs SeedSigner on R36S Handheld Console
data.description: Bitcoin News said on X that a proof of concept developed by @DesobedienteTec has run SeedSigner on the R36S handheld game console, turning the device into a stateless Bitcoin transaction signer. According to Odaily, the handheld costs about $40, has no wireless chip, includes two MicroSD card slots, and can emulate Nintendo, SEGA, PSP, and PS1 games.

data.title: CDC Leaves Pennsylvania Measles Deaths Out of 2026 Outbreak Count
data.description:
The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention did not include two Pennsylvania measles deaths in its 2026 outbreak count for the third straight week, according to Bloomberg.

The omission has fueled staff fears about the agency’s new leader.

data.title: Beijing Stock Exchange Punishes 3 Investors for Private New Share Purchases
data.description: On September 11, China's Beijing Stock Exchange imposed a three-month trading restriction on the securities accounts of three investors for privately buying newly issued shares and agreeing to share IPO gains, according to Jiemian News. The exchange said the investors reached private arrangements during the subscription stage, paid fixed fees or agreed on profit-sharing terms to lock in returns in advance and shift investment risk. It said the conduct bypassed public trading channels, disrupted the order of new share issuance, and harmed market discipline. The exchange warned that off-exchange deals conducted under names such as "buying out funds" or "buying new shares" and involving private transfers or profit-sharing arrangements may violate rules, and urged investors to use compliant channels and make independent decisions.

data.title: Bank of Nassau 1982 Chief Economist Win Thin Says August U.S. CPI Does Not Meet Warsh's 2% Inflation Standard
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Bank of Nassau 1982 Chief Economist Win Thin said the August U.S. CPI data does not seem to meet the standard set by Fed Governor Kevin Warsh for returning inflation to 2%, and he expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates next week as markets have almost fully priced in a rate hike.

data.title: BMO Capital Markets' Ian Lyngen: August CPI Clears Path for Fed Rate Hike Next Week
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, BMO Capital Markets U.S. rates strategy head Ian Lyngen said the August U.S. CPI inflation report cleared the path for an FOMC rate hike next week, and he expects at least one more 25-basis-point hike before year-end. Short-dated bonds weakened, while longer-duration bonds rose.

data.title: The Smarter Web Company Considers Preferred Share Offering on London Stock Exchange
data.description:
The Smarter Web Company is considering issuing preferred shares under the reserved code MORE for trading on the London Stock Exchange main market. The company plans to hold an extraordinary general meeting on September 28 to seek approval for the related authorization matters. According to Foresight News, the preferred shares would offer cumulative variable-rate weekly preferred dividends and liquidation preference, but no voting rights.

The company plans to raise 15 million to 25 million pounds, with dividend payments expected to come from operating cash flow, its Bitcoin treasury, and capital market fundraising. Chief Executive Officer Andrew Webley said that, if approved, it would be the first perpetual preferred share issued by a UK-listed company with a Bitcoin treasury strategy and listed on the London Stock Exchange main market.

data.title: India's Foreign Ministry: Modi Stresses Need for Lasting Peace and Stability in the Region
data.description: According to Jin10, India's Foreign Ministry said that during a meeting with Iranian President Pezeshkian, Indian Prime Minister Modi emphasized the importance of continued efforts to ensure lasting peace and stability in the region.
